name: solid-coding
description: Language-agnostic methodology for writing and refactoring code against SOLID, GoF design patterns, and complementary principles (DRY, KISS, YAGNI, Boy Scout, SoC, Encapsulation, Law of Demeter, CQS, TDD, AHA) — for whole-worktree refactors and live in-flight review alike. Wires into whatever CI/QA a repo already has and verifies every finding through an adversarial reviewer/verifier subagent pair before touching code.
